headings.title: Initialization and Online Routing
headings.assessment: Single predicate, public inputs, no evaluator gold labels, top-k-limited failure set, retrieval misses, and deterministic online commit ordering elaborate the main without conflict. Strict versus fixed-size ranking is essential; keep the lexicographic-versus-arithmetic qualification because unconditional agreement across all retrieval score scales is not established.

headings.title: Held-Out Gate and Partial Rollback
headings.assessment: Strict cold-start comparison and rejection of ties agree with the main equation and method caption. Mean Boolean correctness equals 1 minus error. Per-skill rollback to iteration-start state, unsupported-skill rejection, non-monotonicity relative to the previous retained state, test exclusion, and pre-/post-rollback score distinctions are scientifically useful clarifications, not artifact-quality disclaimers. Main introduction/related-work prose uses looser higher-error phrasing, but the explicit main gate equation resolves ties strictly; do not weaken the appendix rule.
